name: recursive_union_distinct_error
sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree(id, name, depth) AS (SELECT id, name, 0 FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION SELECT c.id, c.name, tree.depth + 1 FROM tree INNER JOIN categories c ON c.parent_id = tree.id) SELECT name, depth FROM tree ORDER BY depth, name;
expected_error: recursive CTE currently supports only UNION ALL
